title: Asahina Mafuyu — How I Really Feel〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Mafuyu.
Do you get your finals back?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'm afraid of what she's going to say when she sees that my grades are starting to slip.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Not just say... What she might do...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And I have another mock exam coming up.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Doing well on that might make up for how I did on my finals...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But Mom might worry if I don't get enough sleep... Then, my only other choice is to study at school during my breaks...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I do that, my lunch break will...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What if you logged onto Nightcord to work on stuff while you're at school during lunch?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know not being able to talk is gonna be tough, Yuki, but let's try to get as much done as we can!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<She'll be fine.
I mean, she doesn't talk much to begin with.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Conversely, Enanan, you don't know when to stop.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hey, what's that supposed to mean?!
We need to communicate if we want to produce good content, right?!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I don't do well on my next exam...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That means I need to study during lunch...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And I should let the others know...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm sorry, but I need to take a break from N25 for a while...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I won't be able to talk with them until I've finished taking my next exam... I won't be able to work on any music...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I... I don't want to send this message... I want to keep making music with them...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I should open the window and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but I was wondering if you'd like to take a bath first or have dinner... Oh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Your window's open. Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, no... I just felt like getting some fresh air...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A bath or dinner? I think I'll have dinner first. I'm actually feeling hungry all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay.
Then, I'll get everything ready.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It shouldn't take long, so please get changed sooner rather than later.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I will. I'm looking forward to dinner.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Thank goodness I was able to hide my phone in time...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Did I press send by accident while trying to hide my phone...? Wait, I should still have time to delete it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena's Message
rows.Line: <A while? How long are we talking here?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line: <Do you need some extra time to study?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <I probably won't be able to join you all until my next mock exam is over.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line: <It's okay. You don't need to apologize. I'll at least be working, so I can just stay logged into Nightcord starting tomorrow so that you can join whenever.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <Yeah, me too♪ You don't necessarily have to get a lot done, so come hang out anytime!>

rows.Speaker: Ena's Message
rows.Line:
<Then, I think I'll stay logged on too.
Come online whenever you feel like it, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line:
<Thank you.
I'll try to log on if I have time.>
